caption: This drawing features a central block of text bordered by a colorful and ornate floral frame. The text at the top reads "THE TEN VIRGINS" in blue, followed by "Matt. xxv. 1–13." in red. Below this is a golden decorative line, and then the main text, which is written in black Gothic script with select letters in red and blue for emphasis. The first letter of the main text is a large, ornate blue and gold initial "T." The border is composed of red, gold, and green leafy scrollwork, with clusters of large, white lilies with yellow centers and green stems appearing on the right and top sides. At the bottom of the border is a prominent depiction of a golden oil lamp, emitting swirling golden and red flames and smoke that blends into the border’s decorative elements. The overall color palette includes gold, red, green, blue, and white, with strong contrasts and intricate detailing throughout the border and initial letter.
title: Illuminated Parable: The Ten Virgins
